about.metaDescription: Meet Alexan Production — one team for both the camera and the keyboard.
about.title: One team for both the code and the camera
about.subtitle: We started as a small team that saw how much time is lost hiring several vendors to finish one piece of work.
about.storyParagraph1: Alexan Production began with a photographer shooting products for online shops, running into the same thing over and over: beautiful photos on a site so slow that people left before seeing them, or a finished site with no decent images to put in it.
about.storyParagraph2: So we put together a team that could do both. These days clients have one conversation with us — from working out what to say, through shooting and editing, to writing the code and looking after it afterwards.
about.value1Body: Ranges are on the site for anyone to see. Nothing new appears on the invoice later.
about.value2Body: Code, master files, usage rights. We do not lock anything to keep you coming back.
about.value3Body: Every project includes a support window, and we still answer questions once it ends.
about.teamTitle: The people you will work with
about.teamSubtitle: A small team doing the work themselves, not passing it along.
